home.title: Visual Math
home.line1: See math instead of memorizing it.
home.line2: Open a topic, move the sliders, and watch the picture and the formulas change.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page is not available. Go back to the home page.

scene.keyboardHint: Arrow keys turn the picture. Esc leaves.
scene.dragHint: Drag to turn the picture. Pinch to zoom.

solid.noWebgl: This device cannot show the 3D picture. Here is a flat picture instead. The sliders and formulas still work.
solid.contextLost: The 3D picture stopped. Here is a flat picture instead. The sliders and formulas still work.
solid.lightOffer: The 3D picture is slow to start. Use the light picture instead?

section.title: The cut
section.miss: The cutting plane does not touch the solid.

topic.exploreFree: You can change the sliders and turn the picture at any step.
topic.noScene: This kind of picture is not ready yet. The steps, formulas and example are below.
topic.resetDone: Everything is back to the start.
topic.shareFailed: The link could not be copied. Copy it here:

report.title: Report a problem
report.intro: Tell us what is wrong with this topic. We do not ask who you are, so please do not write your name or other personal details.

reasons.wrong-math: A number or the math is wrong
reasons.urdu: The Urdu is wrong or unclear

report.thanks: Thank you. We will check it.

errors.rateLimited: You have sent several reports. Please wait {minutes} minutes and try again.
errors.failed: We could not send this. Your note is kept. Please try again.

canvas.traceOff: Move the trace to read the value of each curve.
canvas.shadeBelow: {name}: the region below the curve is shaded
canvas.shadeAbove: {name}: the region above the curve is shaded
canvas.strict: the curve itself is not included
canvas.handle: {name}: drag it, or use the arrow keys

drag.marker: Marker: drag it, or use the arrow keys
drag.bar: Fraction bar {n}: drag its end, or use the arrow keys
drag.circle: Fraction circle: drag the edge, or use the arrow keys
drag.splitCols: Split between columns: drag it, or use the arrow keys
drag.splitRows: Split between rows: drag it, or use the arrow keys
drag.count: Counters: drag, or use the arrow keys
drag.digit: Blocks in the {place} column: drag, or use the arrow keys
drag.percent: Percent: drag, or use the arrow keys

sentence.numberLine: A number line from {min} to {max}, in steps of {step}.
sentence.bar: Bar {n}: {num} of {den} equal parts are filled, which is {lowest}.
sentence.same: Bars {a} and {b} reach the same length: {lowest}.
sentence.circle: A circle cut into {den} equal parts, {num} filled, which is {lowest}.
sentence.area: A rectangle of {rows} rows and {cols} columns has {area} squares.
sentence.placeValue: {value} is {th} thousands, {h} hundreds, {t} tens and {o} ones.
sentence.percent: {count} out of 100 squares are filled: {count} percent.

sentence.balance: The left pan holds {left} (that is {l}) and the right pan holds {right} (that is {r}), when x is {x}.
sentence.tipsLeft: The scale tips to the left.
sentence.tipsRight: The scale tips to the right.
sentence.noRectangle: The tiles for {poly} cannot be arranged into a rectangle.
sentence.machineUndefined: The machine takes {input} and gives no answer.

trig.handle: Angle: drag the point, or use the arrow keys; Page Up and Page Down jump to special angles

sentence.angle: The angle is {deg} degrees, which is {rad} radians.
sentence.tangentUndefined: Tangent is undefined at this angle.
sentence.axis: The point is on an axis.
sentence.sides: The adjacent side is {adj}, the opposite side is {opp} and the hypotenuse is {hyp}. The angle is {angle} degrees.

sentence.dropped: {k} values that are not numbers were left out.
sentence.dotPlot: A dot plot of {n} values, from {min} to {max}; the median is {median}.
sentence.histogram: A histogram of {n} values in {bins} bins from {from} to {to}; the tallest bin holds {tallest}.
sentence.spread: The standard deviation of the sample is {sd}.
sentence.boxplot: A box plot of {n} values: smallest {min}, first quartile {q1}, median {median}, third quartile {q3}, largest {max}. The interquartile range is {iqr}.
sentence.fit: The fitted line has slope {slope} and intercept {intercept}; the correlation r is {r}.
sentence.noFit: No line can be fitted: it needs two points with different x values.
sentence.residuals: The sum of the squared residuals is {sse}.
sentence.normal: A normal distribution with mean {mean} and standard deviation {sd}.
sentence.binomial: A binomial distribution with {n} trials and probability {p}.
sentence.probability: The probability of a value from {from} to {to} is {p}.
sentence.simSpinner: {trials} spins of a spinner with {sectors} equal sectors.
sentence.expected: Each result is expected {percent}% of the time.

library.notFoundTitle: We could not find that page
library.notFoundBody: The page may have moved, or the topic may not be available. Go back and try another way.

search.title: Search
search.found: {count, plural, one {# topic found} other {# topics found}}

map.title: Learning map
map.hint: The picture shows how topics lead to each other: an arrow goes from a topic to the topics that need it. The list below says the same in words, and is the way to read it with a keyboard or a screen reader.
map.empty: No topics yet, so there is no map to show.
